tombstone: Mirror with Deities and Animals Surrounded by Rings of Squares and Semicircles (半圓方枚環繞式神獸鏡), 175–225 CE. China, Eastern Han dynasty (25–220 CE). Bronze; diameter: 11.8 cm (4 5/8 in.); overall: 1.2 cm (1/2 in.); rim: 0.4 cm (3/16 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Gift of Drs. Thomas and Martha Carter in Honor of Sherman E. Lee, 1995.326

inscriptions.inscription:
吾作明鏡，幽凍三商。
雕刻極無（無極）。
inscriptions.inscription_translation:
I made this bright mirror by refining the three metals.
Then I sculpted infinite forms.
